headline: China says AI-assisted labor mediation and arbitration pilots now cover all provincial-level regions
summary: On 2 November 2026, China’s Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security reported expanding the “AI+ mediation and arbitration” pilot to all provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. A May Shenzhen HRSS article says officials from 13 provincial-level jurisdictions shared experience at a workshop; it separately identifies Shenzhen as a designated pilot area in 2025 and does not establish that all 13 attendees were pilot sites or had deployed systems. The article, credited to Nanfang+ client, describes Shenzhen’s local system and reports usage and processing-time metrics that remain unaudited. The national expansion statement does not establish uniform operation, dispute outcomes, fairness, safety or independent effectiveness.
